messages:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty triggered -> P12345: ingress-proxy error_rate(502) > 5% (2m window). Severity: high. Autopage -> @oncall_carol.
incident-bot: automated page fired, runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingress-502.
oncall_carol: acked :white_check_mark: I'm on it, grabbing logs and metrics.
sre_alice: looking at dashboards — /v1/embeddings has a 6.8% 502 rate over the last 2m in us-west2, QPS ~210, 502s ~14/s.
infra_bob: quick check from a host in us-west2:
```
$ curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" -d '{"input":"test"}'
* TCP connection established
> POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream response error"}
```
oncall_carol: restarting ingress-proxy pod on us-west2-canary-1 -> `kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingress-proxy -n prod-usw2`
infra_bob: FYI PD did NOT escalate to infra-team due to dedupe/window config (suppression kicked in). I think second-tier wasn't paged.
product_dave: customer impact? any customers impacted or failing ingests?
oncall_carol: bulk of traffic fine, but 2 large customers show increased retries -> one shows 12% failures over 10m (saw spike around 1758599990). Could be client retries causing higher downstream pressure.
sre_alice: hypothesis: canary churn bumped KV cache evictions -> cold KV cache + a recent proxy config change causes timeout -> 502s. Suggest short mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to dedicated pool, 2) increase proxy upstream timeout to 10s, 3) bump KV cache TTL. Runbook suggests toggling traffic-slice.
infra_bob: prepared command to route embeddings to fallback pool: `redwoodctl traffic-route set --service embeddings --slice fallback-usw2 --weight 100`
oncall_carol: running fallback route now (execute): `redwoodctl traffic-route set --service embeddings --slice fallback-usw2 --weight 100` -> accepted.
sre_alice: monitoring...
(90s later)
oncall_carol: update: 502 rate dropped from 6.8% -> 0.9% within 90s after routing toggle. Latency back to normal. :tada:
eng_sre: thanks. can you also record that PD suppression prevented escalation to infra-team? We should review dedupe window.
incident-bot: tagging incident P12345, adding label: "pd-suppression-observed"; attaching timeline.
product_dave: good catch. I'll ping CS for customers with observed errors so we can notify affected accounts.
sre_alice: next steps: collect heap/profile from affected proxy instances, dump KV cache eviction logs, capture canary rollout events between 1758599500-1758600000. I'll own the RCA.
oncall_carol: handing off to day-shift. @sre_alice will take lead on follow-up. leaving thread open for updates.
sre_alice: noted. I'll post a short postmortem and action items (tweak PD dedupe, add automatic fallback on threshold breach, bump cache TTL) in the next 24h. Closing after PM posted.
pagerduty-bot: Incident P12345 status: mitigated (temporary routing). Please follow runbook for postmortem template.
